image_description: A side-profile view of a female mannequin head wearing a long, dark brown wig with reddish highlights and bangs. The image features prominent, semi-transparent white cursive text overlays ('Lorenz Hair' and 'Collection') across the face and background. The lighting is studio-style, highlighting the sheen of the synthetic hair fibers.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Prominent watermarks/text overlays ('Lorenz Hair', 'Collection') are present. While likely intentional branding, AI generators often struggle with rendering legible, correctly spelled cursive text, resulting in slight character deformations or nonsensical letter connections that mimic text but fail strict OCR tests.
The skin texture on the mannequin is excessively smooth and plastic-like, lacking pore detail or micro-texture, which is common in AI-generated representations of mannequins or dolls.
Slight blending ambiguity where the bangs meet the forehead; individual strands seem to merge into the skin tone slightly rather than sitting distinctly on top, though this is minor.
